Description: Switch and show anything on your MQTT broker.
Name: MQTT Controller

Localization.Switch a light or plug on and off, and s: Switch a light or plug on and off, and see its state.

pi.switch_help: Press: switch on or off. The key shows the state the device reports.
pi.state_topic_hint: Where the device reports its state. Type to search all topics on the broker.
pi.field_placeholder: Field in the JSON, e.g. state
pi.label: Name
pi.command_topic_hint: Where commands go, if not to the state topic (zigbee2mqtt: …/set).
pi.template_hint: {value} becomes the value for on or off. Empty: the value alone.
pi.availability_topic_hint: The key is greyed out while this topic says offline.
pi.retain_hint: The broker keeps the command for new subscribers. Usually off.
pi.broker_address_hint: A host alone means mqtt://host:1883. Also mqtts://, ws:// and wss://.
pi.allow_self_signed_hint: Only for mqtts:// or wss:// with your own certificate.
pi.state_denied: Access denied: check user name and password
pi.state_invalid: That is not a broker address
pi.value_help: Shows the value the device reports, coloured by your colour ranges.
pi.value_topic_hint: Where the device reports the value. Type to search all topics on the broker.

Localization.Show a value with its unit, e.g. a tempe: Show a value with its unit, e.g. a temperature or power, as text or on a half-circle gauge.
